libs.note: BH-3950. The merge conductor's stacked-orphan path: a child whose parent CLOSED unmerged or never had a PR is retargeted to the project base (stack_orphan_retarget in bin/merge-conductor.sh) and then owes a head-bound re-review before it may merge. Applied by rebase.sh at file scope, in a subshell; the code literal after the read is the documented fallback when there is no registry. The STACKED_WAIT TTL the NONE arm reads is the existing MC_TTL_STACKED_WAIT (mc_ttl), not a knob here.

knobs.zero_means: a retarget off a closed or absent parent keeps the review it had (pre-BH-3950), and a NONE parent whose branch is gone is no longer judged on the conflict half alone: the full mc_orphan_clean check runs and parks it orphaned-child
knobs.note: 1 writes `rtreview <key> <head>` after a retarget off a CLOSED-unmerged or PR-less parent, and holds the row on WAIT_REVIEW `retargeted off closed parent - re-review owed` until a claude head-bound re-review of that head, bought after the retarget, APPROVES (`rtcleared <key> <head>`; a provcleared row or verdict that predates the retarget does not release it). It is also what lets a NONE parent's gone branch be judged on the conflict half alone (carry=0). The MERGED arm never owes one. Read as ${MC_RETARGET_REREVIEW:-1}.
